column1: # wt179 · MANUSCRIPTS DELIBERATELY OUTSIDE THE CAPTURE
# One row per docs/papers/*/paper-*.md that is on disk and is NOT in the built deliverable the
# manifest describes. A row is a CLAIM: that this manuscript is deliberately outside the PDF, and
# why. Delete a row and wt179 goes red on the next run, which is how this file is audited rather
# WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT BUY YOU. A new manuscript that nobody declares still turns the guard red
# — that property is why the disk glob was there and it is preserved. This file is the difference
# between "you forgot to rebuild" and "this is a draft and the capture is not supposed to hold it",
# which the guard previously could not say, so it said the wrong one forever on a draft branch.
